# FQHETorusComputeKx

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnTorus` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnTorus/FQHETorusComputeKx`

```text
FQHETorusComputeKx, version 0.01

Usage: FQHETorusComputeKx [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : name of the file containing the state whose Kx momentum has to be computed
    --degenerated-states : name of the file containing a list of states (override input-state)
    -r, --ratio : ratio between lengths along the x and y directions (default value = 1)
    --compute-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the Kx operator in the given basis
    --interaction-name : name that should be inserted in the output file names
    --no-convertion : do not convert the final vectors to the (Kx,Ky) n-body basis
    --invert : assume the input states are in the (Kx,Ky) and express them in the Ky basis
    --invert-real : when using the invert option, assume that the final vector is real
    --export-transformation : export the transformation matrix in a ascii file (one per momentum sector)
    --export-bintransformation : export the transformation matrix in a binary file (one per momentum sector)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

tools options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
